{"test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection2", "test_code": "#nullable enable\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedFormatters_ForStructRecordAndEnum_HaveExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    public enum MyEnum\n    {\n        First = 0,\n        Second = 1,\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public struct MyStruct\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public MyEnum Kind { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public record MyRecord\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public MyEnum Kind { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public record struct MyRecordStruct\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public MyEnum Kind { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> netRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = netRefs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Single(runResult.Results);\n        Assert.Null(runResult.Results[0].Exception);\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterface = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterface);\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? myStruct = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.MyStruct\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? myRecord = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.MyRecord\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? myRecordStruct = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.MyRecordStruct\");\n        INamedTypeSymbol? myEnum = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TestNamespace.MyEnum\");\n        Assert.NotNull(myStruct);\n        Assert.NotNull(myRecord);\n        Assert.NotNull(myRecordStruct);\n        Assert.NotNull(myEnum);\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> allTypes = GetAllTypes(output.Assembly.GlobalNamespace).ToList();\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol[] targetTypes = { myStruct!, myRecord!, myRecordStruct!, myEnum! };\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol targetType in targetTypes)\n        {\n            INamedTypeSymbol? formatter = allTypes.SingleOrDefault(t =>\n                t.AllInterfaces.Any(i =>\n                    SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.OriginalDefinition, formatterInterface!) &&\n                    SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i.TypeArguments[0], targetType)));\n\n            Assert.NotNull(formatter);\n            Assert.Contains(\n                formatter!.GetAttributes(),\n                attr => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(attr.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr!));\n\n            SyntaxReference syntaxRef = Assert.Single(formatter.DeclaringSyntaxReferences);\n            string generatedSource = syntaxRef.SyntaxTree.GetText().ToString();\n            Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", generatedSource);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetAllTypes(INamespaceOrTypeSymbol container)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in container.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return type;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in GetAllTypes(type))\n            {\n                yield return nested;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (container is INamespaceSymbol ns)\n        {\n            foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n            {\n                foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in GetAllTypes(childNs))\n                {\n                    yield return type;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}
